title: NETFLIX_2015_10K.pdf
summary: The section provides a comprehensive overview of Netflix, Inc.'s 2015 Form 10-K, detailing the company's business operations, risk factors, financial performance, and governance structure. It includes information on Netflix's streaming services, membership growth, and revenue generation, as well as selected financial data and management's analysis of operations. The document also addresses legal proceedings, market performance, executive compensation, and internal controls, while referencing additional details in the Proxy Statement for the Annual Meeting of Stockholders. Overall, it highlights Netflix's strategic focus on content and technology, financial health, and compliance with regulatory requirements.

children.title: Netflix 2015 Form 10-K Front Matter
children.summary: This section contains the front matter of Netflix, Inc.'s Form 10-K for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2015. It includes essential company information such as the registrant's name, jurisdiction of incorporation, and IRS Employer Identification Number. The document confirms Netflix's status as a well-known seasoned issuer and provides details on its common stock registered on the NASDAQ. Additionally, it outlines the market value of voting stock held by non-affiliates and the number of outstanding shares as of January 27, 2016. The section also references documents incorporated by reference, specifically the Proxy Statement for the 2016 Annual Meeting of Stockholders.

children.title: Item 1. Business
children.summary: Netflix, Inc. is a leading Internet television network with over 75 million streaming members globally, offering a vast library of TV shows and movies, including original content. The company operates three segments: Domestic streaming, International streaming, and Domestic DVD, generating revenue through monthly membership fees. Netflix's core strategy focuses on expanding its streaming membership and enhancing user experience through improved content and technology. The competitive landscape includes various entertainment providers, and Netflix aims to capture consumer attention during their leisure time. Additionally, the company emphasizes the importance of intellectual property and maintains a workforce of approximately 3,700 employees.

children.title: Item 1A. Risk Factors
children.summary: This section outlines various risk factors that could adversely affect the company's business, financial condition, and operational results. Key risks include challenges in attracting and retaining members due to competition, the impact of piracy on market share, and the long-term fixed costs associated with content commitments. Additionally, the company faces risks related to international operations, including regulatory compliance and cultural adaptation. Other concerns include potential cybersecurity threats, reliance on third-party technology and partners, and the implications of changing government regulations on internet access and consumer protection laws.

children.title: Item 1B. Unresolved Staff Comments
children.summary: This section indicates that there are no unresolved staff comments related to the company's filings or operations. It suggests that the company has addressed all inquiries or issues raised by regulatory staff, which may reflect positively on its compliance and operational transparency. Readers can infer that the absence of unresolved comments may contribute to a more favorable perception of the company's governance and regulatory standing.

children.title: Item 2. Properties
children.summary: This section details the properties of the company, including its corporate headquarters in Los Gatos, California, which spans approximately 370,000 square feet. It outlines recent lease agreements to expand the headquarters by an additional 260,000 square feet, with a 10-year lease term starting post-construction expected in late 2016. The company also leases offices in Beverly Hills and Fremont, California, and has plans for a new 200,000 square foot facility in Los Angeles, with a similar lease term. The section concludes by affirming that the current facilities are adequate for operational needs and that additional space will be available as required.

children.title: Item 3. Legal Proceedings
children.summary: This section references legal proceedings related to the company, indicating that detailed information can be found in Note 6 of Item 8, which covers Financial Statements and Supplementary Data. The section serves to direct readers to the specific location for comprehensive details on any ongoing or past legal issues involving the company. It emphasizes the importance of reviewing the financial statements for a complete understanding of the legal context.

children.title: Item 4. Mine Safety Disclosures
children.summary: This section states that mine safety disclosures are not applicable to the company. It indicates that there are no relevant mine safety issues or disclosures to report, suggesting that the company does not operate in mining or related industries that would require such disclosures.

children.title: Item 5. Market for Registrant’s Common Equity, Related Stockholder Matters and Issuer Purchases of Equity Securities
children.summary: This section provides information on the market for the registrant's common equity, specifically focusing on the trading of its stock on the NASDAQ under the symbol 'NFLX'. It includes a table detailing the high and low sales prices per share for 2014 and 2015, adjusted for a seven-for-one stock split in July 2015. As of January 27, 2016, there were approximately 237 stockholders of record, with a larger number of beneficial owners. The section also notes that the company has not declared or paid any cash dividends and has no intention to do so in the near future. Additionally, a stock performance graph compares the company's cumulative stockholder return with major indices over a five-year period, emphasizing the company's addition to the S&P 500 Index in December 2010.

children.title: Item 6. Selected Financial Data
children.summary: This section presents selected consolidated financial data for the years ended December 31 from 2011 to 2015, including revenues, operating income, net income, and earnings per share, adjusted for a stock split. It details cash flow from operating activities and free cash flow, highlighting significant fluctuations in cash flow over the years. The consolidated balance sheets provide insights into cash, total assets, long-term debt, and stockholders' equity, indicating growth in total assets and equity. Additionally, it includes data on global streaming membership additions and total memberships, reflecting the company's growth in subscriber base.

children.title: Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations
children.summary: This section provides a detailed analysis of the company's financial performance, highlighting key metrics such as global streaming memberships, revenues, operating income, and net income for the years 2013 to 2015. It discusses the growth in international memberships and the impact of foreign currency fluctuations on revenue per membership. The section also breaks down the performance of domestic and international streaming segments, including contribution margins and marketing expenses. Additionally, it outlines the company's investment in content and technology, as well as liquidity and capital resources, emphasizing the need for future financing to support ongoing expansion and content production.

children.title: Item 7A. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk
children.summary: This section discusses the company's exposure to market risks, specifically interest rate and foreign currency risks. It outlines the investment policy aimed at preserving principal while maximizing income, detailing the types of securities held and their classifications. A sensitivity analysis is provided, indicating that a hypothetical 100 basis point increase in interest rates could lead to a $6.6 million decline in the fair market value of the investment portfolio. Additionally, it highlights the impact of foreign currency fluctuations on international revenues, noting a $37.3 million foreign exchange loss for the year ended December 31, 2015, due to currency remeasurement. The section emphasizes the company's lack of hedging strategies for foreign currency risks and the potential significant impact of exchange rate volatility on future operations.

children.title: Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data
children.summary: This section includes the consolidated financial statements and accompanying notes, which are referenced from Part IV, Item 15(a)(1) of the Annual Report on Form 10-K. It outlines the management's evaluation of disclosure controls and procedures, confirming their effectiveness in ensuring timely and accurate reporting as required by the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. Additionally, it discusses the management's assessment of internal control over financial reporting, which was found effective as of December 31, 2015, and notes that this assessment was audited by Ernst & Young LLP. There were no changes in internal control over financial reporting that materially affected its effectiveness during the specified quarter.

children.title: Item 9. Changes in and Disagreements with Accountants on Accounting and Financial Disclosure
children.summary: This section reports that there were no changes or disagreements with accountants regarding accounting and financial disclosure. It indicates that the company has maintained consistent practices in its financial reporting and has not encountered any issues that would necessitate disclosure. Readers can learn that the company has a stable relationship with its accountants and has not faced any significant challenges in its financial disclosures during the reporting period.

children.title: Item 9A. Controls and Procedures
children.summary: This section discusses the evaluation of disclosure controls and procedures by Netflix's management, specifically by the CEO and CFO, confirming their effectiveness as of the end of the reporting period. It emphasizes that while these controls provide reasonable assurance for timely and accurate disclosures, they cannot prevent all errors or fraud. Additionally, it details the management's assessment of internal control over financial reporting, which was found effective based on COSO criteria, and notes that there were no changes in internal controls that materially affected their effectiveness during the reporting period. An independent audit by Ernst & Young LLP corroborates the effectiveness of these internal controls as of December 31, 2015.

children.title: Item 9B. Other Information
children.summary: This section, Item 9B, indicates that there is no additional information to report. It explicitly states 'None,' suggesting that there are no updates, disclosures, or relevant details that need to be communicated in this section. Readers can conclude that all pertinent information has been covered in previous sections without any further notes or clarifications required here.

children.title: Item 10. Directors, Executive Officers and Corporate Governance
children.summary: This section provides information about the company's directors and executive officers, referencing details from the Proxy Statement for the Annual Meeting of Stockholders. It includes topics such as the election of directors, compliance with beneficial ownership reporting, and the company's code of ethics. Readers can learn about the governance structure and ethical guidelines that govern the actions of the company's leadership.

children.title: Item 11. Executive Compensation
children.summary: This section references the executive compensation details found in the Proxy Statement for the Annual Meeting of Stockholders, specifically under the section titled 'Compensation of Executive Officers and Other Matters.' Readers can learn about the compensation structure, including salaries, bonuses, stock options, and other financial benefits provided to executive officers. It serves to inform shareholders about how executives are compensated and the rationale behind these compensation packages.

children.title: Item 12. Security Ownership of Certain Beneficial Owners and Management and Related Stockholder Matters
children.summary: This section references information about the security ownership of certain beneficial owners and management, as well as related stockholder matters. It indicates that detailed data can be found in the Proxy Statement for the Annual Meeting of Stockholders, specifically under the sections titled 'Security Ownership of Certain Beneficial Owners and Management' and 'Equity Compensation Plan Information.' Readers can learn about the ownership stakes of key stakeholders and the structure of equity compensation plans.

children.title: Item 13. Certain Relationships and Related Transactions, and Director Independence
children.summary: This section references information about certain relationships and related transactions involving the company, as well as the independence of its directors. Readers can learn about any potential conflicts of interest, transactions with related parties, and the criteria used to determine director independence. The details are incorporated by reference from the company's Proxy Statement for the Annual Meeting of Stockholders, which provides a comprehensive overview of these topics.

children.title: Item 14. Principal Accounting Fees and Services
children.summary: This section provides information regarding the fees and services of the principal independent registered public accounting firm. It indicates that detailed information can be found under the caption "Proposal Two: Ratification of Appointment of Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm" in the Proxy Statement for the Annual Meeting of Stockholders. Readers can learn about the specific accounting fees and the nature of services provided by the accounting firm.

children.title: Item 15. Exhibits, Financial Statement Schedules
children.summary: This section outlines the exhibits and financial statement schedules included in Netflix's Annual Report on Form 10-K. It specifies that the financial statements are detailed in Item 8, while financial statement schedules are omitted as they are deemed not applicable. The section also provides an index to the financial statements, including the report of the independent auditor, consolidated statements of operations, comprehensive income, cash flows, balance sheets, and stockholders' equity. Additionally, it includes notes to the consolidated financial statements that cover significant accounting policies, revenue recognition, and the impact of recent accounting standards.
